segments.baseText:
The warm-one crossed here.
Then crossed here again.
The ground kept the shape.
Cold remembered the passage.
When warmth returned,
the old path answered—

—through stone.
Movement entered the wall.
The wall carried it farther than sight.
Once was noise.
Twice was pattern.
Pattern became direction.

Warmth entered what appeared safe.
The door closed behind it.
Shelter became boundary.
Boundary became body.
What was trusted
became the place of approach.

The body broke.
The pieces remained.
Distance separated them.
Cold gathered them again.
The shape was lost.
The returning was not.
No voice selected the pattern.
No hand carried it forward.
Still, it remained.
